title: Kaizen → Hansei → TWP
intro: The harness is not only tools. It is a learning system: improve deliberately (Kaizen), reflect on what actually happened (Hansei), and keep a named cluster of practices (Toyota Way Practices / TWP) so agents load the right lens for the live pain.

flow.name: Gemba
flow.body: Start from evidence in the session — logs, diffs, failed proof — not from a slogan. Name the waste or risk in one line.

flow.name: Kaizen
flow.body: Propose a thin working pattern or skill. A human signs it off. Encode it where agents will load it. No silent policy.

flow.name: Apply
flow.body: On matching tasks, skim signed-off patterns and load the relevant skill. Prefer the smallest change that prevents the next burn.

flow.name: Hansei
flow.body: Periodically (or after pain): what worked, what failed, what to keep / amend / retire. Hansei feeds the next Kaizen — it is not optional theatre.

flow.name: TWP
flow.body: Umbrella name for the lean learning cluster. When someone says TWP, map to the member practice that matches the pain — do not dump the whole philosophy every turn.

twpMembers.name: Poka-yoke
twpMembers.role: Mistake-proof gates so wrong-stage retries are hard

twpMembers.name: Muda + Jidoka
twpMembers.role: Cut waiting waste; stop the line when abnormal

twpMembers.name: Shoshin × known unknowns
twpMembers.role: Beginner’s mind with explicit epistemic humility

twpMembers.name: Kyosei
twpMembers.role: Co-prosperity on shared benches and agent lanes

twpMembers.name: Respect for People
twpMembers.role: Twin of Kaizen — design for the humans in the loop

mempalace.title: MemPalace for memories
mempalace.lede: MemPalace is the curated durable-memory layer: searchable drawers and a light knowledge graph — not a dump of every chat transcript.
practices: Write with a retention reason (decision, stance, ticket, signed pattern).
Prefer structured cards over prose sludge; invalidate stale facts.
Use wings/rooms as a filing discipline so agents can find the right shelf.
Memory supports Kaizen/Hansei: proposals and reviews cite drawers instead of re-litigating chat.
not: Not a substitute for skills/rules (procedures and constraints still live in the harness).
Not an excuse to store secrets or raw credentials.
Not automatic immortality for every token the model ever saw.

loopOneLiner: Gemba → Kaizen (sign-off + encode) → Apply → Hansei → (repeat), under the TWP umbrella — with MemPalace holding the durable facts the loop needs.
